33387.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **minikube** — VM yoki container ichida to'liq K8s, addon'lar ko'p, o'rganish uchun qulay. **kind** — Docker container'lari ichida node'lar, tez yaratiladi/o'chadi, CI testlari uchun ideal. **k3s** — yengil, bitta binary, production'ga ham yaraydi (edge, IoT, kichik server).

**Nega kerak:** har test uchun bulutda cluster ochish qimmat va sekin. Lokal cluster bilan manifest, Helm chart, operator'ni noutbukda tekshirasiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
minikube:  host -> VM/docker -> bitta "node" (to'liq kubeadm)
kind:      host -> docker -> [control-plane container][worker container]...
k3s:       host -> k3s binary (apiserver+kubelet+containerd+sqlite/etcd)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# kind — CI'da ko'p ishlatiladi
cat <<EOF > kind.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
nodes: [{role: control-plane}, {role: worker}, {role: worker}]
EOF
kind create cluster --name dev --config kind.yaml
kind load docker-image api:dev --name dev    # lokal image'ni cluster'ga
kind delete cluster --name dev

minikube start --cpus 4 --memory 8g && minikube addons enable ingress
curl -sfL https://get.k3s.io | sh -           # k3s server
```

| | minikube | kind | k3s |
|---|---|---|---|
| Asosiy maqsad | o'rganish | CI/test | yengil prod/edge |
| Multi-node | bor | oson | bor |
| LoadBalancer | `minikube tunnel` | MetalLB kerak | ServiceLB bor |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Lokalda ishladi = prod'da ishlaydi emas: StorageClass, LoadBalancer, IAM, CNI farq qiladi.
- kind'da `imagePullPolicy: Always` + lokal image — pull xatosi; `kind load` va `IfNotPresent` ishlating.
- k3s default'da Traefik va flannel bilan keladi — prod konfiguratsiyangizdan farq qilishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** CI'da kind bilan ephemeral cluster ochib Helm chart + integration test o'tkazish — "YAML to'g'ri" va "ilova ishlaydi" orasidagi bo'shliqni yopadi. Muhim — cluster versiyasini prod bilan bir xil pin qiling.

33388.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `imagePullPolicy`: **Always** — har pod start'da registry'dan manifestni tekshiradi; **IfNotPresent** — node'da bo'lsa yuklamaydi; **Never** — faqat lokal. Tag `latest` bo'lsa (yoki tag yo'q bo'lsa) default `Always`, aks holda `IfNotPresent`. `latest` xavfli, chunki u **o'zgaruvchan** — qaysi kod ishlayotganini bilmaysiz.

**Muammo:** 3 ta pod `api:latest`. Kimdir yangi `latest` push qildi. Bitta pod qayta tug'ildi va yangi kodni oldi, ikkitasi eski — bir Deployment ichida ikki versiya, rollback qiladigan joy yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
tag   (o'zgaruvchan ko'rsatkich):  api:latest -> sha256:aaa (kecha)
                                    api:latest -> sha256:bbb (bugun)
digest (o'zgarmas):                api@sha256:aaa  -> doim bir xil
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
containers:
- name: api
  image: ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0@sha256:3f1c...   # tag o'qish uchun, digest aniqlik uchun
  imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
```
```bash
crane digest ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0       # digest olish
kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].imageID}'   # haqiqatda ishlayotgan digest
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `latest` bilan `kubectl rollout undo` foydasiz — oldingi revision ham `latest`.
- Pod spec o'zgarmagani uchun yangi `latest` push qilinsa deploy bo'lmaydi.
- `Always` registry ishlamay qolsa yangi pod'larni ko'tarmaydi (rate limit — Docker Hub).

**Senior nuqta:** Immutable tag (git SHA yoki semver) + registry'da tag immutability yoqilgan + admission policy (Kyverno: `latest` taqiqlash, faqat imzolangan digest) — supply chain xavfsizligi va takrorlanuvchanlikning asosi.

33389.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `cordon` — node'ni "unschedulable" qiladi (yangi pod tushmaydi, eskilari qoladi). `drain` — cordon + mavjud pod'larni xavfsiz evict qiladi (PDB'ni hurmat qiladi). `uncordon` — node'ni yana ishga qaytaradi.

**Nega kerak:** kernel yangilash, node upgrade, hardware almashtirish oldidan node'ni bo'shatish kerak — servis to'xtamasdan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
cordon:  node.spec.unschedulable=true
drain:   cordon -> har pod uchun Eviction API
                  -> PDB ruxsat bersa pod o'chadi, boshqa node'da qayta tug'iladi
                  -> PDB ruxsat bermasa kutadi/qayta urinadi
uncordon: unschedulable=false
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
kubectl cordon worker-3
kubectl get nodes          # STATUS: Ready,SchedulingDisabled
kubectl drain worker-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=10m
# ... texnik ish, reboot ...
kubectl uncordon worker-3
```
Flag'lar: `--ignore-daemonsets` (DaemonSet pod'lari baribir qayta tushadi), `--delete-emptydir-data` (emptyDir ma'lumoti yo'qolishiga rozilik), `--force` (controller'siz yalang'och pod'lar — ular qayta tug'ilmaydi!).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- PDB `minAvailable` = replika soni bo'lsa drain abadiy qotadi ("Cannot evict pod as it would violate the pod's disruption budget").
- Bitta replika'li ilova — drain paytida downtime.
- `uncordon`ni unutish — node bo'sh turadi, cluster sig'imi kamayadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Managed node group'larda (EKS, GKE) upgrade drain'ni avtomatik qiladi, Karpenter esa node'larni o'zi almashtiradi — shuning uchun to'g'ri PDB, graceful shutdown va kamida 2 replika har bir servis uchun majburiy standart bo'lishi kerak.

33390.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **k9s** — terminal UI: resurslar bo'ylab klaviatura bilan yurish, log, exec, delete bir tugma. **Lens/Freelens** — desktop GUI, ko'p cluster, grafiklar. **krew** — `kubectl` plugin menejeri: `ctx/ns`, `stern`, `neat`, `tree`, `who-can` kabi plugin'lar.

**Nega kerak:** `kubectl get pods -n x`, `describe`, `logs -f` ni kuniga yuzlab yozish vaqtni yeydi. Vosita o'qish/navigatsiyani tezlashtiradi, lekin tushunishni almashtirmaydi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
k9s --context prod -n payments --readonly   # :pods, :deploy, l=log, s=shell, d=describe
kubectl krew install ctx ns stern neat tree who-can
kubectl ctx prod && kubectl ns payments
stern 'api-.*' --since 10m                  # ko'p pod log'i bir oqimda, rangli
kubectl get deploy api -o yaml | kubectl neat   # status/managedFields'siz toza YAML
kubectl tree deploy api                     # Deployment -> RS -> Pod daraxti
kubectl who-can delete pods -n prod         # RBAC audit
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- k9s'da `Ctrl+D` bilan prod'da tasodifan delete — `--readonly` rejimi yoki prod context uchun alohida config.
- krew plugin'lari uchinchi tomon kodi — kubeconfig credential'laringiz bilan ishlaydi. Ishonchli manba va versiyani tekshiring.
- GUI'ga o'rganib qolib, incident paytida (faqat SSH + kubectl bo'lganda) yo'qolib qolish.

**Senior nuqta:** Vositalar shaxsiy samaradorlik uchun; jamoaviy jarayon (deploy, o'zgarish) baribir Git va CI orqali. Junior'larga avval `kubectl` + `jsonpath`ni o'rgating, keyin k9s.

33391.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Downward API — pod o'zi haqidagi ma'lumotni (nom, namespace, IP, node nomi, label/annotation, resurs request/limit) env yoki fayl orqali olishi. `fieldRef` va `resourceFieldRef` ishlatiladi; API server'ga so'rov va RBAC kerak emas.

**Nega kerak:** log'ga pod nomini yozish, metrika label'i, Java/Go'ga memory limitni bildirish (`GOMEMLIMIT`, heap hajmi), leader election identifikatori.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubelet pod'ni ishga tushirayotganda:
  metadata.name, status.podIP, spec.nodeName ...  --> env yoki /etc/podinfo/*
  limits.memory                                    --> env (bayt)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
containers:
- name: api
  env:
  - name: POD_NAME
    valueFrom: { fieldRef: { fieldPath: metadata.name } }
  - name: POD_NAMESPACE
    valueFrom: { fieldRef: { fieldPath: metadata.namespace } }
  - name: NODE_NAME
    valueFrom: { fieldRef: { fieldPath: spec.nodeName } }
  - name: GOMEMLIMIT
    valueFrom:
      resourceFieldRef: { resource: limits.memory, divisor: "1" }
  volumeMounts: [{ name: podinfo, mountPath: /etc/podinfo }]
volumes:
- name: podinfo
  downwardAPI:
    items:
    - path: labels
      fieldRef: { fieldPath: metadata.labels }
```
```bash
kubectl exec api-x -- env | grep POD_
kubectl exec api-x -- cat /etc/podinfo/labels
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Label/annotation'lar faqat **volume** orqali yangilanadi; env start'da muzlaydi.
- `GOMEMLIMIT` ni limitning 100%iga tenglash — GC kech ishga tushadi; ~90% qiling (kodda yoki alohida hisob).
- Limit qo'yilmagan bo'lsa `limits.cpu` node'ning allocatable qiymatini qaytaradi — chalg'ituvchi.

**Senior nuqta:** Downward API — kodni K8s API'ga bog'lamasdan kontekst berishning eng arzon usuli. Pod'ga ServiceAccount token berib API'dan o'zi o'qishidan ko'ra xavfsizroq (least privilege).

33392.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `crictl` — CRI (Container Runtime Interface) uchun CLI: containerd/CRI-O bilan node darajasida pod sandbox, container, image'larni ko'rish. Ishlatiladi: kubelet yoki apiserver ishlamay qolganda, `kubectl` ma'lumot bermaganda, image pull/runtime muammosini node'da tekshirishda. Docker endi K8s runtime emas (dockershim 1.24 da olib tashlangan), shuning uchun `docker ps` node'da hech narsa ko'rsatmasligi mumkin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubectl -> apiserver -> kubelet --CRI gRPC--> containerd -> runc -> container
                                    ^
              crictl -----------------+   (node'da, root sifatida)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# /etc/crictl.yaml: runtime-endpoint: unix:///run/containerd/containerd.sock
crictl ps -a                         # container'lar (o'lganlari ham)
crictl pods --name api               # pod sandbox'lar
crictl logs --tail 50 <container-id>
crictl inspect <container-id> | jq '.info.runtimeSpec.process.args'
crictl images | grep api
crictl pull ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0   # pull muammosini to'g'ridan tekshirish
crictl stats                         # CPU/memory
crictl rmi --prune                   # ishlatilmagan image'lar (disk to'lganda)
```
Ish oqimi: node `NotReady` -> SSH -> `systemctl status kubelet containerd` -> `journalctl -u kubelet -n 100` -> `crictl ps -a`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `crictl` bilan container yaratish/o'chirish kubelet'ni chalkashtiradi — u holatni qayta tiklaydi. Asosan faqat o'qish uchun ishlating.
- `ctr` (containerd'ning o'z CLI) namespace'ga ega: K8s container'lari `k8s.io` namespace'ida (`ctr -n k8s.io containers ls`).
- Node'ga root kirish — kuchli huquq; managed node'larda SSM/`kubectl debug node` afzal.

**Senior nuqta:** `crictl` — kubelet va runtime orasidagi chegarani ko'rsatadigan vosita: agar `crictl` container'ni ko'rsa, lekin `kubectl` ko'rmasa, muammo kubelet <-> apiserver aloqasida; ko'rmasa — runtime darajasida.

33393.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Static pod — apiserver orqali emas, to'g'ridan **kubelet** tomonidan node'dagi papkadagi (odatda `/etc/kubernetes/manifests/`) YAML fayldan ishga tushiriladigan pod. kubeadm cluster'ida control plane komponentlari (kube-apiserver, etcd, controller-manager, scheduler) aynan static pod sifatida ishlaydi — "tovuq va tuxum" muammosini hal qiladi: apiserver hali yo'q ekan, uni kim ishga tushiradi? — kubelet.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
kubelet (systemd service)
   | staticPodPath: /etc/kubernetes/manifests (kuzatadi)
   v
etcd.yaml, kube-apiserver.yaml, kube-controller-manager.yaml, kube-scheduler.yaml
   -> containerd orqali container'lar
   -> apiserver ko'tarilgach kubelet "mirror pod" yaratadi (kubectl'da ko'rinadi, lekin tahrirlab bo'lmaydi)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
ls /etc/kubernetes/manifests/
grep staticPodPath /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml
kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide | grep -E "apiserver|etcd"   # nomi oxirida node nomi
# apiserver flag'ini o'zgartirish: faylni tahrirlash -> kubelet o'zi qayta yaratadi
sudo vi /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-apiserver.yaml
crictl ps | grep kube-apiserver        # apiserver ishlamasa kubectl ham ishlamaydi
journalctl -u kubelet -f
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `kubectl delete pod kube-apiserver-cp1` — mirror pod qayta paydo bo'ladi; haqiqiy boshqaruv fayl orqali.
- Manifestda YAML xatosi — apiserver ko'tarilmaydi, `kubectl` ishlamaydi; tuzatish faqat node'da `crictl` va `journalctl` bilan.
- Tahrirlashdan oldin faylni shu papkaga nusxalab qo'yish (`.bak`) — kubelet uni ham pod sifatida ishga tushirishi mumkin; zaxirani boshqa papkaga saqlang.
- Static pod'lar sertifikat fayllariga bog'liq — kubeadm sertifikatlari 1 yilda tugaydi (`kubeadm certs check-expiration`).

**Senior nuqta:** Managed cluster'larda bu tafsilot yashirin, lekin self-managed (kubeadm, bare-metal) cluster'da control plane'ni tiklash bilimi aynan shu: kubelet + manifest + sertifikat + etcd. Runbook'da yozib qo'ying.

33394.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Admission controller'lar — so'rov autentifikatsiya va RBAC'dan o'tgandan keyin, lekin etcd'ga yozilishidan **oldin** ishlaydigan plugin'lar. **Mutating** — obyektni o'zgartiradi (sidecar qo'shish, default label/resource). **Validating** — faqat ruxsat beradi yoki rad etadi (policy). Webhook'lar — bu mantiqni tashqi servisga chiqarish (Kyverno, Gatekeeper, Istio injector). 1.30+ da webhook'siz `ValidatingAdmissionPolicy` (CEL) ham GA.

**Muammo (himoya):** RBAC "kim" qila olishini aytadi, lekin "nima" qilishni emas — dasturchi pod yaratish huquqi bilan privileged pod yoki `latest` image yaratishi mumkin. Admission policy shu bo'shliqni yopadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
so'rov -> AuthN -> AuthZ (RBAC) -> Mutating admission (ketma-ket)
       -> schema validatsiya -> Validating admission (parallel) -> etcd
Webhook: apiserver --HTTPS (AdmissionReview)--> servis -> allowed: true/false (+ JSON patch)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata: { name: no-latest-tag }
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
    - { apiGroups: ["apps"], apiVersions: ["v1"], operations: ["CREATE","UPDATE"], resources: ["deployments"] }
  validations:
  - expression: "object.spec.template.spec.containers.all(c, !c.image.endsWith(':latest'))"
    message: "latest tag taqiqlangan"
```
(+ `ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding` bilan namespace'larga bog'lanadi)
```bash
kubectl get validatingwebhookconfigurations,mutatingwebhookconfigurations
kubectl get validatingadmissionpolicies
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Webhook servisi ishlamasa va `failurePolicy: Fail` — butun cluster'da pod yaratish to'xtaydi (kube-system ham!). `namespaceSelector` bilan tizim namespace'larini chiqarib tashlang, webhook'ni HA qiling.
- `failurePolicy: Ignore` — xavfsizlik policy'si jimgina o'chadi.
- Webhook timeout (default 10s) — API so'rovlarini sekinlashtiradi.
- Mutating webhook'lar tartibi kafolatlanmagan — bir-biriga bog'liq mutatsiyalardan qoching.

**Senior nuqta:** Policy-as-code: qoidalarni Git'da saqlang, avval `audit`/`warn` rejimida, keyin enforce. Oddiy qoidalar uchun ichki CEL (ValidatingAdmissionPolicy) — tashqi webhook'ga nisbatan kamroq ishlamay qolish nuqtasi.

33395.a:
```sh
kubectl get ns old-team -o jsonpath='{.spec.finalizers}{.metadata.finalizers}'
kubectl api-resources --verbs=list --namespaced -o name | \
  xargs -n1 kubectl get -n old-team --ignore-not-found --show-kind
# qolgan CR'lar, ularning controller'i (operator) allaqachon o'chirilgan
```
Sabablar: operator o'chirilgan, lekin uning CR'larida finalizer qolgan; APIService ishlamayapti (`kubectl get apiservice` — False).
To'g'ri yo'l: controller'ni qaytarib tozalashga imkon berish. Finalizer'ni qo'lda olib tashlash (`kubectl patch ... -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":null}}' --type=merge`) — tashqi resurslar (LB, disk) yetim qolishi mumkin.
`--cascade=orphan` — egasini o'chirib, bolalarini qoldirish.

33396.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `dnsPolicy` pod'ning `/etc/resolv.conf`ini belgilaydi: **ClusterFirst** (default, CoreDNS orqali, cluster nomlari ishlaydi), **Default** (node'ning resolv.conf'ini meros oladi — cluster nomlari ishlamaydi!), **ClusterFirstWithHostNet** (hostNetwork pod uchun cluster DNS), **None** (`dnsConfig` bilan to'liq qo'lda). `hostNetwork: true` — pod node'ning tarmoq namespace'idan foydalanadi: node IP'si, node portlari.

**Muammo:** CNI agenti yoki node-exporter `hostNetwork: true` bilan ishlaydi, lekin Service nomini resolve qila olmaydi — chunki hostNetwork'da ClusterFirst jimgina `Default` ga tushadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ClusterFirst:  pod resolv.conf -> nameserver 10.96.0.10 (CoreDNS), search <ns>.svc.cluster.local ...
Default:       pod resolv.conf = node /etc/resolv.conf
hostNetwork:   pod IP = node IP, port 9100 node'da band qilinadi
               + dnsPolicy ClusterFirstWithHostNet -> CoreDNS
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
spec:
  hostNetwork: true
  dnsPolicy: ClusterFirstWithHostNet
---
spec:
  dnsPolicy: None
  dnsConfig:
    nameservers: [10.96.0.10]
    searches: [prod.svc.cluster.local, svc.cluster.local]
    options: [{ name: ndots, value: "2" }]
```
```bash
kubectl exec pod-x -- cat /etc/resolv.conf
kubectl get pod pod-x -o jsonpath='{.spec.hostNetwork} {.spec.dnsPolicy}'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- hostNetwork pod'lari bir node'da bir xil portni ishlata olmaydi — replika soni node soni bilan cheklanadi.
- hostNetwork — NetworkPolicy ko'pincha qo'llanmaydi va pod node'ning barcha interfeyslarini ko'radi; Pod Security `baseline` uni taqiqlaydi. Faqat tizim agentlariga.
- `dnsPolicy: Default` nomi chalg'ituvchi — u default emas.

**Senior nuqta:** hostNetwork'ni xavfsizlik istisnosi sifatida qarang: alohida namespace, aniq sabab, policy bilan ruxsat ro'yxati. Oddiy ilovaga node portini ochish kerak bo'lsa — Service (NodePort/LoadBalancer) yoki `hostPort` emas, ingress/gateway ishlating.

33397.a:
**Qisqa javob:** PriorityClass pod'ga prioritet raqami beradi. Joy yetmasa scheduler **preemption** qiladi: past prioritetli pod'larni evict qilib, yuqori prioritetli pod'ni joylaydi. Tizim komponentlari uchun `system-cluster-critical` va `system-node-critical` tayyor.

**Muammo:** cluster to'la, to'lov servisining yangi pod'i Pending, holbuki node'larda batch hisobot pod'lari ishlayapti. Kim muhimroq ekanini scheduler bilishi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
payments (priority 100000) Pending, joy yo'q
   |
   v
scheduler: qaysi node'da past prioritetli pod'larni chiqarsa sig'adi?
   node-b: batch (priority 100) x2 -> evict (graceful)
   |
   v
payments -> node-b (nominatedNodeName)
Eviction'da ham kubelet prioritetni hisobga oladi.
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1
kind: PriorityClass
metadata: { name: business-critical }
value: 100000
globalDefault: false
description: "To'lov va checkout"
---
apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1
kind: PriorityClass
metadata: { name: batch-low }
value: 100
preemptionPolicy: Never      # o'zi hech kimni chiqarmaydi
---
spec:
  priorityClassName: business-critical
```
```bash
kubectl get priorityclass
kubectl get pods -A -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,PRIO:.spec.priority
kubectl get events -A --field-selector reason=Preempted
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hamma jamoa o'zini "critical" qiladi — prioritet ma'nosiz bo'ladi. ResourceQuota bilan `scopeSelector` orqali priorityClass ishlatishni cheklang.
- Preemption PDB'ni "imkon qadar" hurmat qiladi, kafolat emas.
- `system-*-critical` klasslarni oddiy ilovaga berish — kube-system komponentlarini siqib chiqarishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Overprovisioning hiylasi: manfiy prioritetli "pause" pod'lar bo'sh joyni band qiladi; haqiqiy pod kelganda ular darhol preempt bo'ladi va Cluster Autoscaler/Karpenter yangi node qo'shadi — keskin yuk uchun issiq zaxira.

33398.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `console` — ifoda va funksiyalarni interaktiv sinash (REPL); `graph` — dependency grafini DOT formatda chiqarish; `output` — output qiymatlarini o'qish; `show` — state yoki saqlangan plan'ni o'qiladigan/JSON ko'rinishda ko'rsatish. Ular debug va CI avtomatizatsiyasi uchun.

**Amalda:**
```bash
terraform console
> cidrsubnet("10.0.0.0/16", 8, 3)
"10.0.3.0/24"
> [for s in ["a","b"] : upper(s)]
["A", "B"]
> aws_instance.web.private_ip
"10.0.1.15"
> local.tags

terraform output                         # hamma output
terraform output -raw public_ip          # skript uchun xom qiymat
terraform output -json | jq .

terraform show                           # joriy state
terraform show tf.plan                   # saqlangan plan
terraform show -json tf.plan | jq -r '.resource_changes[]
  | select(.change.actions | index("delete")) | .address'

terraform graph | dot -Tsvg > graph.svg  # Graphviz kerak
```

| Buyruq | Asosiy foydasi |
|---|---|
| `console` | `for`, `cidrsubnet`, regex'ni apply'siz sinash |
| `output -raw` | bash skript va CI'ga qiymat uzatish |
| `show -json` | plan'ni policy/skript bilan tekshirish |
| `graph` | sikl va ortiqcha `depends_on` ni topish |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `console` state'ni lock qiladi — CI apply paytida ishlatmang.
- `output -raw` faqat string/number uchun; murakkab tur uchun `-json`.
- Katta loyihada `graph` o'qib bo'lmas darajada katta — `-type=plan` va filtrlang.

**Senior nuqta:** `show -json` — OPA/Conftest yoki oddiy `jq` bilan "delete yo'q", "public bucket yo'q" kabi policy-as-code tekshiruvlarining asosi.

33399.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `dynamic` blok — resurs ichidagi **ichki blokni** (`ingress`, `setting`, `rule`) ro'yxat bo'yicha takroran yaratish usuli. Resursning o'zini emas, faqat uning ichidagi bloklarni ko'paytiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
var.ingress_ports = [80, 443]
dynamic "ingress" { for_each ... content {...} }
   -> ingress { from_port = 80 ... }
   -> ingress { from_port = 443 ... }
```

**Amalda:**
```hcl
variable "ingress_ports" {
  type    = list(number)
  default = [80, 443]
}

resource "aws_security_group" "web" {
  name   = "web"
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id

  dynamic "ingress" {
    for_each = var.ingress_ports
    content {
      from_port   = ingress.value     # iterator nomi = blok nomi
      to_port     = ingress.value
      protocol    = "tcp"
      cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
    }
  }
}
```
Iterator nomini o'zgartirish: `iterator = port` -> `port.value`. Map bo'lsa `.key` va `.value`.

Ko'pincha aniqroq muqobil — alohida resurs:
```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule" "web" {
  for_each          = toset([for p in var.ingress_ports : tostring(p)])
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.web.id
  from_port         = tonumber(each.key)
  to_port           = tonumber(each.key)
  ip_protocol       = "tcp"
  cidr_ipv4         = "0.0.0.0/0"
}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ichma-ich `dynamic` — kodni o'qib bo'lmaydi.
- Inline blok ro'yxatidagi o'zgarish butun blokni qayta yozadi — diff katta va tushunarsiz.
- Inline qoidalar va alohida rule resurslarini aralashtirish — ular bir-birini doimiy "tuzatadi" (drift).

**Senior nuqta:** `dynamic` — modulga moslashuvchanlik berish uchun, lekin oddiy konfiguratsiyada statik bloklar o'qilishi osonroq. Mumkin bo'lsa alohida resurs + `for_each`: har qoidaning o'z manzili bor.

33400.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Provisioner'lar (`local-exec`, `remote-exec`, `file`) resurs yaratilgandan keyin ixtiyoriy skript ishga tushiradi. Ular "oxirgi chora", chunki Terraform ularning natijasini bilmaydi va boshqarmaydi: idempotent emas, plan'da ko'rinmaydi, xato bo'lsa resurs "tainted" bo'ladi. `terraform_data` — ularni biriktirish uchun provider'siz "bo'sh" resurs (`null_resource` o'rnini bosuvchi).

**Muammo:**
```
plan: + aws_instance.web       (skript haqida hech narsa yo'q)
apply: instance OK -> remote-exec (SSH) timeout -> instance TAINTED
keyingi apply: instance qayta yaratiladi
```

**Amalda:**
```hcl
resource "terraform_data" "migrate" {
  triggers_replace = [var.app_version]   # versiya o'zgarsa qayta ishlaydi
  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command     = "./scripts/migrate.sh ${var.app_version}"
    environment = { DB_HOST = aws_db_instance.main.address }
  }
}
```

**Yaxshiroq muqobillar:**
| Vazifa | Muqobil |
|---|---|
| Birinchi boot sozlash | `user_data` / cloud-init |
| Dastur o'rnatish | Packer bilan tayyor AMI |
| Server konfiguratsiyasi | Ansible (Terraform'dan keyin) |
| DB migratsiya | CI/CD pipeline qadami yoki K8s Job |
| API'da yo'q narsa | provider/resurs qidiring |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `remote-exec` SSH kalit, ochiq port va tarmoq kirishini talab qiladi — CI'da mo'rt, xavfsizlikka zid.
- Skript idempotent bo'lmasa, qayta ishlaganda zarar.
- `when = destroy` provisioner'lar ishonchsiz — ko'p holatda ishlamay qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Provisioner ko'rsangiz — vazifani to'g'ri qatlamga ko'chirish mumkinligini so'rang: image (Packer), boot (cloud-init), config (Ansible), deploy (CI/CD). Terraform infratuzilma holatini boshqarsin, protseduralarni emas.

33401.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **SQS** — navbat: xabarlar saqlanadi va iste'molchi o'zi tortib oladi (bir xabarni bitta iste'molchi qayta ishlaydi). **SNS** — pub/sub: bitta xabar darhol barcha obunachilarga push qilinadi, saqlanmaydi. **EventBridge** — event bus: hodisalarni mazmuni bo'yicha qoidalar bilan filtrlab, ko'p maqsadlarga yo'naltiradi, AWS servis va SaaS hodisalari, jadval, archive/replay bilan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
SQS:  producer -> [queue] <- consumer (poll), muvaffaqiyatdan keyin delete
SNS:  producer -> topic -> push -> SQS A, SQS B, Lambda, email
EB:   "S3 ObjectCreated" / "order.created" -> rule (filtr) -> Lambda / SQS / Step Functions
Fan-out pattern: SNS -> SQS A (billing), SQS B (email) -- har biri mustaqil retry
```

| | SQS | SNS | EventBridge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Model | queue (pull) | pub/sub (push) | event bus + rules |
| Iste'molchi | bitta guruh | ko'p | ko'p, mazmun filtri bilan |
| Saqlash | 14 kungacha | yo'q | archive/replay |
| Misol | background job | bitta hodisani ko'pga | "fayl tushsa", cron, SaaS |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws sqs send-message --queue-url $Q --message-body '{"orderId":42}'
aws sqs receive-message --queue-url $Q --wait-time-seconds 20 --max-number-of-messages 10
aws sqs delete-message --queue-url $Q --receipt-handle "$RH"
aws sns publish --topic-arn $T --message '{"orderId":42}'
aws events put-events --entries '[{"Source":"shop","DetailType":"order.created","Detail":"{\"id\":42}"}]'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- SQS Standard — at-least-once va tartib kafolatsiz: handler idempotent bo'lsin; tartib kerak bo'lsa FIFO (throughput cheklangan).
- Visibility timeout ishlov vaqtidan qisqa — xabar ikki marta qayta ishlanadi.
- DLQ (`maxReceiveCount`) siz — "zaharli" xabar abadiy aylanadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Asinxron dizaynda asosiy savollar: yetkazish kafolati, tartib, idempotentlik, qayta urinish va DLQ monitoringi. DLQ'dagi xabarlar soni — majburiy alert.

33402.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **ECS** — AWS'ning o'z konteyner orkestratori (task, service, cluster), oddiy va AWS bilan chuqur integratsiyalangan. **Fargate** — serverless compute: node/EC2 boshqarmasdan task/pod bo'yicha to'laysiz (ECS va EKS bilan ishlaydi). **EKS** — managed Kubernetes: standart K8s API, katta ekotizim, lekin murakkabroq va control plane pullik.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ECS service "api" (desired 3) -> task definition (image, CPU, xotira, IAM task role)
   compute: EC2 capacity provider  yoki  Fargate (node yo'q)
EKS: Deployment -> pod'lar -> node group (EC2) yoki Fargate profile / Karpenter
```

| | ECS | EKS |
|---|---|---|
| API | AWS'ga xos | Kubernetes |
| O'rganish | oson | qiyin |
| Ekotizim | AWS integratsiya | Helm, operator'lar, multi-cloud |
| Control plane | bepul | ~$73/oy har cluster |
| Upgrade | deyarli yo'q | har ~14 oyda K8s versiya |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ecs update-service --cluster prod --service api --force-new-deployment
aws ecs describe-services --cluster prod --services api \
  --query 'services[].deployments[].[status,rolloutState,runningCount]'
aws eks update-kubeconfig --name prod && kubectl get pods -A
```

| Compute | Afzallik | Kamchilik |
|---|---|---|
| EC2 | katta yukda arzon, GPU, DaemonSet | node patch va scale sizda |
| Fargate | node yo'q, izolyatsiya | qimmatroq, cold start, DaemonSet/GPU yo'q |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Kichik jamoa "trend" uchun EKS tanlaydi — keyin upgrade, CNI, add-on'larni boshqarishga vaqt ketadi.
- Fargate'da har task uchun resurs minimumi va narx — doimiy katta yukda EC2 arzonroq.
- ECS task role va execution role farqini adashtirish (ilova ruxsatlari vs image pull/log).

**Senior nuqta:** Faqat AWS, kichik-o'rta jamoa — ECS + Fargate ko'pincha eng sodda va arzon operatsion yo'l. EKS — portativlik, K8s ekotizimi yoki platforma jamoasi bor bo'lsa.

33403.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **AWS Organizations** — ko'p AWS akkauntini markaziy boshqarish: OU (organizational unit) ierarxiyasi, umumiy billing, markaziy siyosatlar. **SCP (Service Control Policy)** — OU/akkauntdagi **maksimal** ruxsat chegarasi: hatto akkaunt admini ham undan oshib o'tolmaydi. Multi-account — eng kuchli izolyatsiya chegarasi: blast radius, xavfsizlik, xarajat va kvotalarni ajratadi.

**Nega bitta akkaunt yomon:**
```
bitta akkaunt: dev'dagi xato IAM / skript -> prod resurslarini o'chiradi
               dev API limitlari prod'ni bo'g'adi, xarajatni ajratib bo'lmaydi
multi-account: har muhit/jamoa alohida akkaunt -> xato faqat o'z chegarasida
```

**Tuzilma:**
```
Root (management) -- faqat billing va org boshqaruvi, workload yo'q
 +-- OU Security    : log-archive, audit
 +-- OU Infra       : network, shared-services
 +-- OU Workloads
      +-- prod      : payments-prod, api-prod
      +-- nonprod   : dev, staging
 +-- OU Sandbox     : tajriba akkauntlari (budget bilan)
```

**Amalda (SCP):**
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    { "Sid": "DenyOtherRegions", "Effect": "Deny", "NotAction": ["iam:*","sts:*","organizations:*","support:*"],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": { "StringNotEquals": { "aws:RequestedRegion": ["eu-central-1"] } } },
    { "Sid": "ProtectCloudTrail", "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": ["cloudtrail:StopLogging","cloudtrail:DeleteTrail","guardduty:DeleteDetector"],
      "Resource": "*" }
  ]
}
```
```bash
aws organizations list-accounts --query 'Accounts[].[Name,Id,Status]' --output table
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Region deny SCP'da global servislarni (IAM, STS, CloudFront) istisno qilmaslik — ular ishlamay qoladi.
- SCP ruxsat **bermaydi** — faqat cheklaydi; IAM policy baribir kerak.
- Management akkauntda workload ishlatish — SCP u yerga ta'sir qilmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Control Tower / Landing Zone Accelerator bu tuzilmani avtomatik quradi (CloudTrail, Config, guardrail'lar). Odamlar IAM Identity Center orqali kerakli akkauntga rol bilan kiradi — har akkauntda IAM user yo'q.

33404.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **CloudTrail** — "kim, qachon, qayerdan, qaysi API'ni chaqirdi" audit jurnali. **GuardDuty** — loglar (CloudTrail, VPC Flow, DNS) asosida tahdidlarni avtomatik aniqlaydi (kripto-mayning, kompromat credential, g'alati API faolligi). **AWS Config** — resurslar konfiguratsiyasi tarixi va qoidalarga mosligini (compliance) kuzatadi. **Security Hub** — barcha topilmalarni bir joyda yig'adi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
API chaqiruv --> CloudTrail (log-archive S3) --> "SG'ni kim ochdi?"
CloudTrail + VPC Flow + DNS --> GuardDuty (ML, threat intel) --> finding
resurs o'zgarishi --> Config (holat tarixi + rule) --> NON_COMPLIANT
hammasi --> Security Hub --> EventBridge --> Slack / ticket / avtomatik tuzatish
```

| Servis | Savol | Misol |
|---|---|---|
| CloudTrail | Kim nima qildi? | "SG'ni kim 0.0.0.0/0 ga ochdi?" |
| GuardDuty | Hujum bormi? | EC2 mining pool'ga ulanmoqda |
| Config | Holat qoidaga mosmi, qanday o'zgargan? | shifrlanmagan EBS ro'yxati |
| Security Hub | Umumiy holat | CIS / FSBP benchmark ball |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress \
  --max-results 5 --query 'Events[].[EventTime,Username]'
aws guardduty list-findings --detector-id $D --finding-criteria '{"Criterion":{"severity":{"Gte":7}}}'
aws configservice describe-compliance-by-config-rule --compliance-types NON_COMPLIANT
```
EventBridge qoidasi — root login'da alert:
```json
{ "detail-type": ["AWS Console Sign In via CloudTrail"],
  "detail": { "userIdentity": { "type": ["Root"] } } }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- CloudTrail faqat bitta region'da yoki o'sha akkauntdagi bucket'da — hujumchi izni o'chiradi. Organization trail, alohida log-archive akkaunt, Object Lock.
- GuardDuty yoqilgan, lekin finding'larni hech kim ko'rmaydi — EventBridge orqali alert/ticket.
- Config hamma resurs turlarini yozsa — xarajat; kerakli turlarni tanlang.

**Senior nuqta:** Minimum baseline: organization-wide CloudTrail + GuardDuty + Config, log-archive'da o'zgarmas saqlash, yuqori severity'ga avtomatik alert. Bularsiz incident'da "nima bo'ldi?" ga javob topib bo'lmaydi.

33405.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **VPC peering** — ikki VPC'ni to'g'ridan 1:1 bog'laydi (tranzitiv emas). **Transit Gateway** — markaziy hub: ko'p VPC, VPN va Direct Connect'ni hub-and-spoke bilan bog'laydi, tranzitiv routing. **PrivateLink** — tarmoqlarni emas, bitta **servisni** boshqa VPC'ga xususiy endpoint sifatida ochadi (CIDR kesishsa ham ishlaydi).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Peering:        VPC A <----> VPC B <----> VPC C   (A -> C yo'q! to'r o'sib ketadi)
Transit GW:     VPC A --\
                VPC B ---[ TGW ]--- VPN / Direct Connect (ofis)
                VPC C --/
PrivateLink:    consumer VPC [interface endpoint ENI] --> NLB --> provider servisi
```

| | VPC peering | Transit Gateway | PrivateLink |
|---|---|---|---|
| Topologiya | 1:1 | hub-and-spoke | servis -> iste'molchi |
| Tranzitiv | yo'q | ha | - |
| CIDR kesishishi | mumkin emas | mumkin emas | mumkin |
| Narx | faqat trafik | soat + GB | soat + GB |
| Misol | 2-3 VPC | 10+ VPC, gibrid tarmoq | SaaS, boshqa jamoa API'si |

**Amalda:**
```bash
aws ec2 create-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-id vpc-a --peer-vpc-id vpc-b
# har ikki tomonda route table'ga yo'nalish qo'shish kerak!
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-a --destination-cidr-block 10.1.0.0/16 \
  --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-123

aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-a --service-name com.amazonaws.eu-central-1.s3 \
  --route-table-ids rtb-a                                   # gateway endpoint (bepul)
aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-a --vpc-endpoint-type Interface \
  --service-name com.amazonaws.eu-central-1.ecr.dkr --subnet-ids subnet-1 subnet-2
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Peering'dan keyin route'larni va SG'larni unutish — ulanish "ishlamaydi".
- Peering to'ri: 10 VPC = 45 ta ulanish — boshqarib bo'lmaydi; TGW'ga o'ting.
- TGW orqali katta trafik — GB to'lovi sezilarli; ma'lumot ko'p almashadigan juftliklar uchun peering arzonroq.

**Senior nuqta:** Tarmoq topologiyasi tashkilot tuzilmasini aks ettiradi: platforma — TGW hub; jamoalar orasidagi servis kontraktlari — PrivateLink (minimal ochiqlik, tarmoq bog'lanishisiz). AWS servislariga esa doim VPC endpoint'lar.

33406.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `git restore` — tracked fayldagi o'zgarishni bekor qiladi yoki unstage qiladi; `git clean` — **untracked** fayllarni o'chiradi. Ikkalasi ham qaytarib bo'lmaydigan amal: commit qilinmagan narsa reflog'da yo'q.

**Vaziyat:** Eksperimentdan keyin repo iflos: o'zgargan fayllar, yangi temp fayllar, build artefaktlar. Toza holatga qaytish kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
tracked + o'zgargan  --git restore-->   HEAD/index holatiga
staged               --git restore --staged--> unstage
untracked            --git clean-->     o'chiriladi
ignored (.gitignore) --git clean -x-->  o'chiriladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
git restore main.go               # o'zgarishni tashlash (eski: checkout -- main.go)
git restore --staged main.go      # unstage (eski: reset HEAD main.go)
git restore --source=HEAD~2 main.go   # eski versiyani olish
git clean -n                      # DRY RUN: nima o'chishini ko'rish
git clean -fd                     # untracked fayl + papkalar
git clean -fdx                    # + ignored (build/, node_modules, .env!)
git clean -i                      # interaktiv tanlash
```
`-n` chiqishi: `Would remove tmp/debug.log` — ro'yxatni o'qib, keyin `-f`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `-x` lokal `.env`, IDE sozlamalarini ham o'chiradi.
- `restore` dan keyin "orqaga" yo'q — ikkilansangiz `git stash -u` qiling (qaytsa bo'ladi).
- `clean` submodule ichiga kirmaydi, `-ff` kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Xavfli tozalashdan oldin har doim `git stash -u` — bu bepul sug'urta. CI'da toza checkout uchun `git clean -ffdx` standart.

33407.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SemVer — `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` versiyalash kelishuvi: MAJOR — orqaga mos kelmaydigan (breaking) o'zgarish, MINOR — mos keladigan yangi funksiya, PATCH — mos keladigan bug fix. Versiya raqami foydalanuvchiga "yangilash xavflimi" degan signal beradi.

**Muammo:** Kutubxona `1.4` dan `1.5` ga o'tdi va kodingiz buzildi — demak muallif breaking change'ni minor qilib chiqargan. SemVer shu kelishuvni rasmiylashtiradi.

**Misollar:**
```
1.4.2 -> 1.4.3   bug fix
1.4.3 -> 1.5.0   yangi endpoint, eskilari ishlaydi
1.5.0 -> 2.0.0   API'dan maydon olib tashlandi
2.0.0-rc.1       pre-release (2.0.0 dan past)
0.x.y            boshlang'ich: har minor breaking bo'lishi mumkin
```

**Constraint'lar:**
| Yozuv | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| `^1.4.0` (npm) | >=1.4.0 <2.0.0 |
| `~1.4.0` (npm) | >=1.4.0 <1.5.0 |
| `~> 5.60` (Terraform) | >=5.60, <6.0 |
| `~> 5.60.1` (Terraform) | >=5.60.1, <5.61 |

**Amalda (avtomatlashtirish):**
```bash
# Conventional Commits -> versiya
feat: ...           -> minor
fix: ...            -> patch
feat!: ... / BREAKING CHANGE: -> major
npx semantic-release   # yoki release-please GitHub Action: tag + CHANGELOG
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Go modullarida v2+ import yo'lida `/v2` bo'lishi shart (`module example.com/lib/v2`).
- Lock fayl bo'lmasa `^` diapazon har build'da boshqa versiya olishi mumkin.
- "Breaking" faqat API emas — default qiymat yoki xatti-harakat o'zgarishi ham.

**Senior nuqta:** SemVer — va'da, kafolat emas. Lock fayl + avtomatik dependency PR (Renovate/Dependabot) + test — haqiqiy himoya.

33408.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Submodule — bir repo ichiga boshqa repo'ni **aniq commit** bo'yicha ulash. Ota repo faqat `.gitmodules` (URL) va gitlink (commit hash) saqlaydi. Muammolari ko'p (unutilgan update, push qilinmagan commit), shuning uchun ko'pincha package manager yoki monorepo yaxshiroq.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
app/ (ota repo)
  .gitmodules: third_party/proto -> https://github.com/acme/proto.git
  third_party/proto  = gitlink 7a6b5c4 (aniq commit)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
git submodule add https://github.com/acme/proto.git third_party/proto
git clone --recurse-submodules URL
git submodule update --init --recursive    # clone'dan keyin unutilgan bo'lsa
git submodule update --remote              # upstream'ning oxirgi commit'iga
git add third_party/proto && git commit -m "bump proto"
git config --global submodule.recurse true # pull/switch submodule'ni ham yangilaydi
```
CI (GitHub Actions):
```yaml
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
  with: { submodules: recursive, token: ${{ secrets.SUBMODULE_TOKEN }} }
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Submodule ichida commit qilib, uni push qilmay ota repo'ni push qilish — boshqalar mavjud bo'lmagan commit'ga ishora oladi.
- Submodule ichida detached HEAD — u yerda qilingan ish yo'qolishi oson.
- `git pull` submodule'ni avtomatik yangilamaydi — eski kod bilan build.

**Muqobillar:**
| Usul | Qachon |
|---|---|
| Package manager (Go modules, npm) | versiyalangan kutubxona |
| Monorepo | kod birga o'zgaradi |
| `git subtree` | kodni ichiga ko'chirish, alohida clone shart emas |

**Senior nuqta:** Submodule'ni faqat haqiqatan mustaqil versiyalanadigan, package manager bo'lmagan narsalar (proto, firmware, vendor C kod) uchun ishlating.

33409.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `delegate_to` — task'ni joriy host **nomidan**, lekin boshqa hostda bajarish (masalan, LB'da serverni o'chirish); `run_once` — task'ni guruh bo'yicha faqat bir marta bajarish (DB migratsiya); `local_action` / `delegate_to: localhost` — task'ni control node'da bajarish (API chaqiruv, Slack xabari).

**Qanday ishlaydi (rolling deploy):**
```
for host in web (serial: 1):
  lb1: disable web1        <- delegate_to: lb1
  web1: deploy, restart
  lb1: enable web1
bir marta: DB migration    <- run_once
localhost: Slack "deployed" <- delegate_to: localhost
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
- hosts: web
  serial: 1
  tasks:
    - name: LB'dan chiqarish
      community.general.haproxy:
        state: disabled
        host: "{{ inventory_hostname }}"
        backend: app
      delegate_to: lb1

    - name: DB migration (bir marta)
      ansible.builtin.command: /opt/app/bin/migrate
      run_once: true

    - name: Slack'ga xabar
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: "{{ slack_hook }}"
        method: POST
        body_format: json
        body: { text: "deploy {{ inventory_hostname }}" }
      delegate_to: localhost
      become: false

    - name: LB'ga qaytarish
      community.general.haproxy: { state: enabled, host: "{{ inventory_hostname }}", backend: app }
      delegate_to: lb1
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `run_once` + `serial` — har batch'da bir marta ishlaydi, butun play'da emas. Migratsiyani alohida play'ga chiqaring.
- `delegate_to` da o'zgaruvchilar (`ansible_host`, facts) **asl** hostniki bo'ladi — chalkashlik; `delegate_facts: true` kerak bo'lishi mumkin.
- `delegate_to: localhost` + `become: true` — laptopingizda sudo so'raladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Rolling deploy'ning to'g'ri tartibi: drain (delegate) -> deploy -> health check -> enable (delegate), `max_fail_percentage` bilan. Migratsiyalar backward-compatible bo'lishi kerak — eski va yangi kod bir vaqtda ishlaydi.

33410.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `split` faylni qatorlar (`-l`) yoki hajm (`-b`) bo'yicha bo'laklarga bo'ladi, `cat` ularni qayta birlashtiradi (keyin checksum bilan tekshiriladi). Tasodifiy satr — `openssl rand` yoki `/dev/urandom`. `base64` — binary'ni matnga **kodlash** (shifrlash emas!): `base64` / `base64 -d`.

**Muammo:** 20 GB backup'ni 5 GB cheklovli joyga (email, eski FAT32, ba'zi upload limitlari) yuborish; parol/token generatsiya qilish; K8s Secret uchun qiymat tayyorlash.

**Amalda — split/cat:**
```bash
split -l 25 data.txt part_                  # 25 qatordan: part_aa, part_ab ...
split -b 100M -d backup.tar.gz bk_          # 100 MB, raqamli suffiks: bk_00, bk_01
split -n 4 -d big.iso iso_                  # teng 4 bo'lak
sha256sum backup.tar.gz > orig.sha256
cat bk_* > backup.tar.gz                    # glob tartibi alfavit — suffikslar shunga mos
sha256sum -c orig.sha256                    # birlashma to'g'rimi
```

**Amalda — random va base64:**
```bash
openssl rand -hex 16                        # 32 hex belgi (128 bit)
openssl rand -base64 24                     # 32 belgi
tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' </dev/urandom | head -c 20; echo
uuidgen

echo -n 'admin:s3cret' | base64             # YWRtaW46czNjcmV0
echo 'YWRtaW46czNjcmV0' | base64 -d         # admin:s3cret
base64 -w0 cert.pem                         # bitta qatorda (GNU), K8s/JSON uchun
kubectl create secret generic db --from-literal=password="$(openssl rand -base64 24)"
kubectl get secret db -o jsonpath='{.data.password}' | base64 -d
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `echo` (`-n`siz) yangi qatorni ham kodlaydi — parol oxirida `\n`, autentifikatsiya sirli ravishda ishlamaydi.
- base64 — shifrlash emas: K8s Secret'ni har kim decode qila oladi; himoya RBAC, etcd encryption at rest, tashqi secret manager.
- `$RANDOM` (0-32767) — kriptografik emas, parol uchun yaramaydi.
- `split` suffiks uzunligi yetmasa (`-a`) — "output file suffixes exhausted".
- macOS `base64` flaglari farq qiladi (`-D` eski versiyalarda, `-w` yo'q).

**Senior nuqta:** Sirlar uchun generatsiya — kriptografik manbadan (`openssl rand`, `/dev/urandom`) va saqlash — secret manager'da (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), shell history yoki Git'da emas. Katta fayllarni bo'lish o'rniga ko'pincha multipart upload (`aws s3 cp` avtomatik qiladi) yoki `rsync --partial` to'g'riroq.

33411.a:
**Qisqa javob:** SSH mijoz serverning **host key**'ini birinchi ulanishda `~/.ssh/known_hosts` ga saqlaydi. Keyingi safar kalit boshqacha bo'lsa — mijoz to'xtaydi: bu **MITM hujumi** bo'lishi mumkin yoki server qayta o'rnatilgan / IP boshqa serverga berilgan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
1-ulanish: server kaliti SHA256:abc -> "yes" -> known_hosts:42 ga yoziladi
keyingi:   server kaliti SHA256:xyz != abc -> WARNING, ulanish to'xtatiladi
Sabablar:  - server qayta o'rnatildi / image'dan qayta yaratildi (normal)
           - IP boshqa VM'ga berildi (cloud'da tez-tez)
           - kimdir trafikni ushlab turibdi (MITM) - xavfli!
```

**To'g'ri harakat:**
```bash
# 1) Kalit haqiqatan o'zgarganini ISHONCHLI kanal orqali tasdiqlang:
#    cloud konsol / serial output / admin
sudo ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub   # server tomonda fingerprint
# 2) Mos kelsa, eski yozuvni o'chiring:
ssh-keygen -R web1.example.com
ssh-keygen -R 10.0.1.20
# 3) Qayta ulanib, ko'rsatilgan fingerprint'ni solishtiring
ssh web1.example.com
```
AWS'da fingerprint'ni konsol chiqishidan olish mumkin: `aws ec2 get-console-output --instance-id i-xxx`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `StrictHostKeyChecking=no` yoki `UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null` ni doimiy ishlatish — MITM himoyasini butunlay o'chiradi.
- Fingerprint'ni solishtirmasdan `ssh-keygen -R` qilish — himoya ma'nosi yo'qoladi.
- Auto Scaling'da har yangi instance yangi kalit — shuning uchun jamoalar tekshiruvni o'chirishga moyil.

**Senior nuqta (himoya):** Avtomatlashtirishda tekshiruvni o'chirish o'rniga: **SSH host sertifikatlari** (CA imzolagan host key; mijozda bitta `@cert-authority *.example.com ...` qatori) yoki known_hosts'ni IaC orqali (DNS SSHFP yozuvlari, provisioning chiqishidan) to'ldiring.

33412.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kernel moduli — reboot'siz yuklanadigan kernel kodi (drayver, fayl tizimi, netfilter). `lsmod` — yuklanganlar, `modprobe` — bog'liqliklari bilan yuklash/olib tashlash (`-r`), `modinfo` — ma'lumot. Boot'da yuklash: `/etc/modules-load.d/*.conf`.

**Nega kerak:** Masalan Kubernetes node'ga `br_netfilter` kerak — busiz bridge trafigi iptables'dan o'tmaydi va Service'lar ishlamaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
modprobe br_netfilter
   v
/lib/modules/$(uname -r)/modules.dep dan bog'liqlik (bridge) topiladi
   v
insmod bridge.ko -> insmod br_netfilter.ko -> kernel ichida ishlaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
lsmod | grep br_netfilter
sudo modprobe br_netfilter
sudo modprobe -r pcspkr              # olib tashlash
modinfo overlay | head               # fayl, versiya, parametrlar
# boot'da avtomatik:
printf "overlay\nbr_netfilter\n" | sudo tee /etc/modules-load.d/k8s.conf
# o'chirib qo'yish:
echo "blacklist nouveau" | sudo tee /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-nouveau.conf
sudo update-initramfs -u             # Debian; RHEL: dracut -f
```
K8s uchun bunga qo'shimcha: `net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables=1`, `net.ipv4.ip_forward=1` (`/etc/sysctl.d/`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `insmod` bog'liqliklarni yuklamaydi — har doim `modprobe`.
- Blacklist modul initramfs'da qolgan bo'lsa ishlamaydi — initramfs'ni qayta yig'ing.
- Secure Boot yoqilgan bo'lsa imzosiz modul (NVIDIA DKMS) yuklanmaydi — MOK bilan imzolash kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Node provisioning'ni (Ansible/cloud-init) modul + sysctl bilan idempotent qiling va boot'dan keyin tekshiring. Xavfsizlik uchun kerak bo'lmagan modullarni (`dccp`, `sctp`, `usb-storage`) `install X /bin/false` bilan bloklash CIS benchmark talabi.

33413.a:
**Qisqa javob:** CPU — `lscpu`, `nproc`; xotira — `free -h`; disklar — `lsblk`; anakart/RAM slotlari — `dmidecode`; PCI qurilmalar (NIC, GPU) — `lspci`; umumiy — `hostnamectl`, `systemd-detect-virt`.

**Nega kerak:** Yangi serverga kelganda "bu nima?" degan savolga 1 daqiqada javob: nechta core, RAM qancha, NUMA bormi, VM mi yoki bare metal, qaysi NIC.

**Amalda:**
```bash
lscpu | grep -E 'Model name|^CPU\(s\)|Thread|NUMA|Hypervisor'
nproc                                   # foydalanish mumkin bo'lgan CPU soni
free -h                                 # 'available' ustuniga qara
lsblk -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT,MODEL
sudo dmidecode -t system                # ishlab chiqaruvchi, serial
sudo dmidecode -t memory | grep -E 'Size|Speed'
lspci | grep -i -E 'ethernet|nvidia'
hostnamectl                             # OS, kernel, virtualization
systemd-detect-virt                     # kvm / none
```

**Chiqishni o'qish:**
```
CPU(s):              16
Thread(s) per core:  2      <- 8 fizik core + HyperThreading
NUMA node(s):        2      <- DB uchun NUMA muhim
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Konteyner ichida `nproc`/`free` ko'pincha **host** qiymatini ko'rsatadi, cgroup limitini emas — `cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max`, `memory.max`.
- `free` dagi `free` ustuni kam bo'lsa vahima qilmang — page cache; `available` muhim.
- `dmidecode` root talab qiladi va VM'da ko'p qiymat soxta (hypervisor beradi).

**Senior nuqta:** JVM/Go runtime'lar CPU sonini o'zi aniqlaydi — eski versiyalar konteyner limitini ko'rmasdan juda ko'p thread ochardi. Yangi JDK va Go 1.25+ cgroup'ni hisobga oladi, eski versiyalarda `GOMAXPROCS`/`-XX:ActiveProcessorCount` ni qo'lda bering.

33414.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Network namespace** — jarayonga o'zining alohida tarmoq stekini beradi (interfeyslar, route jadvali, iptables, portlar). **veth** — ikki uchli virtual kabel: bir uchi namespace ichida (konteynerdagi `eth0`), ikkinchisi host'da (bridge'ga ulangan). Docker/CNI aynan shu primitivlardan foydalanadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
[netns red]                  [host]
 veth-red 10.10.0.2  ==veth==  veth-host 10.10.0.1
                                  |
                              bridge (docker0 / cni0)
                                  |
                              iptables MASQUERADE (NAT)
                                  |
                                eth0 -> internet
```

**Amalda (qo'lda konteyner tarmog'i):**
```bash
sudo ip netns add red
sudo ip link add veth-host type veth peer name veth-red
sudo ip link set veth-red netns red
sudo ip addr add 10.10.0.1/24 dev veth-host && sudo ip link set veth-host up
sudo ip netns exec red ip addr add 10.10.0.2/24 dev veth-red
sudo ip netns exec red ip link set veth-red up
sudo ip netns exec red ip link set lo up
sudo ip netns exec red ping -c1 10.10.0.1
# internetga chiqish:
sudo ip netns exec red ip route add default via 10.10.0.1
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
sudo iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.10.0.0/24 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
```
Haqiqiy konteynerni debug qilish (image'da tool yo'q bo'lsa ham):
```bash
PID=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' web)
sudo nsenter -t $PID -n ip a
sudo nsenter -t $PID -n ss -tlnp
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `lo` ni `up` qilishni unutish — namespace ichida `localhost` ishlamaydi.
- `ip_forward=0` — konteyner internetga chiqmaydi.
- Docker yaratgan namespace'lar `ip netns list` da ko'rinmaydi (`/var/run/netns` ga link yo'q) — `nsenter` ishlating.

**Senior nuqta:** Bu mexanizmni bilish CNI muammolarini (pod tarmog'i yo'q, MTU, NAT) "qora quti"siz debug qilishga imkon beradi. Xavfsizlik: `hostNetwork: true` pod'i namespace izolyatsiyasini yo'qotadi va host portlarini ko'radi — faqat zarur system pod'larga bering.

33415.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin app` — system UID diapazonida, home'siz, interaktiv login'siz servis user'i. **`/etc/skel`** — yangi user'ning home direktoriyasiga `useradd -m` paytida nusxalanadigan shablon fayllar (`.bashrc`, `.profile`).

**Nega servis user'i:** Ilova root sifatida ishlasa, buzilganda butun server ketadi. Alohida user — o'z fayllaridan tashqariga tegolmaydi. `nologin` — hatto parol yoki kalit sizib chiqsa ham shell ochilmaydi.

**Amalda:**
```bash
sudo useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin app
id app                      # uid=998(app) gid=998(app)
getent passwd app           # app:x:998:998::/home/app:/usr/sbin/nologin
sudo -u app /opt/app/bin/server   # shu user nomidan ishga tushirish
sudo su - app               # "This account is currently not available."

ls -a /etc/skel             # .bashrc .profile .bash_logout
sudo useradd -m -s /bin/bash alice   # /home/alice + skel nusxasi
```
systemd'da:
```ini
[Service]
User=app
Group=app
# yoki user yaratmasdan:
DynamicUser=yes
StateDirectory=app      # /var/lib/app, avtomatik egalik
```

**skel'dan foydalanish:** jamoa uchun umumiy `.bashrc` (prompt, alias, `HISTTIMEFORMAT`) shu yerga qo'yilsa, keyingi barcha yangi user'larga tushadi. Mavjud user'larga ta'sir qilmaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `nologin` SSH port-forwarding va `sudo -u` ni to'xtatmaydi; parolsiz, lekin `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` li user'larni tekshir.
- `--no-create-home` bo'lsa ham passwd'da home yo'li yoziladi — ilova u yerga yozmoqchi bo'lsa xato beradi.
- Ilova fayllarini `app` ga tegishli qilib, kodni ham yoziladigan qilish — buzilgan ilova o'z kodini o'zgartiradi. Kod root'ga, faqat data `app` ga.

**Senior nuqta:** `DynamicUser=yes` + `StateDirectory=` + `ProtectSystem=strict` — zamonaviy systemd'da servis izolyatsiyasining eng kam kuch talab qiladigan yo'li.

33416.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Matrix build** — bitta job'ni bir nechta parametrlar kombinatsiyasida (Go versiyalari x OS) avtomatik parallel ishga tushirish: moslikni bir PR'da tekshirasiz. **Cache** — dependency va build natijalarini ishga tushirishlar orasida saqlab, har safar noldan yuklamaslik: CI vaqtini bir necha baravar qisqartiradi.

**Muammo:** Kutubxonangiz Go 1.24 va 1.25 da, Linux va macOS'da ishlashi kerak — 4 ta job'ni qo'lda yozish takror. Har job har safar 300 MB dependency yuklaydi — 5 daqiqa behuda.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
matrix: go=[1.24,1.25] x os=[ubuntu,macos]  -> 4 ta parallel job

cache:
 kalit = os + hash(go.sum)
   topildi  -> tiklash (soniyalar)
   topilmadi -> yuklash -> job oxirida saqlash
 go.sum o'zgarsa -> yangi kalit -> yangi kesh
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        go: ["1.24", "1.25"]
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with: { go-version: "${{ matrix.go }}", cache: true }   # go mod + build cache
      - run: go test -race ./...
```
Docker layer kesh:
```yaml
- uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
  with:
    cache-from: type=gha
    cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
```
Log'da `Cache restored from key: ...` yoki `Cache not found` — keshlash ishlayotganini tekshirish.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `fail-fast: true` (default) — bitta kombinatsiya yiqilsa qolganlari bekor; qaysilar ishlashini bilmaysiz.
- Kesh kalitida lockfile hash yo'q — eski dependency'lar.
- Keshga test natijalari yoki build artefaktlarini qo'yish — eskirgan "yashil" natija.
- Matrix 3x3x3 = 27 job — runner limiti va pul.

**Senior nuqta:** PR'da kichik matrix (asosiy kombinatsiya), to'liq matrix — main yoki tungi build'da. Fork PR'lar keshga yozmasligi kerak — cache poisoning xavfi.

33417.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **SAST** — manba kodni ishga tushirmasdan zaiflikka tahlil (PR'da). **SCA** — dependency'lardagi ma'lum CVE'lar va litsenziyalar (PR'da va muntazam). **DAST** — ishlab turgan ilovaga tashqaridan hujum simulyatsiyasi (staging'da). **SonarQube quality gate** — PR/branch uchun sifat chegaralari (yangi kodda coverage, bug, zaiflik) — o'tmasa merge bloklanadi.

**Muammo:** Xavfsizlikni release oldidan bir martalik "audit" bilan tekshirish — kech va qimmat. Har bosqichda tegishli tekshiruv bo'lsa, xato paydo bo'lgan joyda arzon tuzatiladi ("shift left").

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
PR:      lint -> unit -> SAST (semgrep) -> SCA (govulncheck/trivy) -> secret scan
           -> build image -> image scan -> quality gate (yangi kod: cov>=80%, 0 critical)
staging: deploy -> DAST (ZAP baseline) -> e2e
prod:    faqat imzolangan image (admission policy)
```

| Tur | Nimani ko'radi | Qayerda | Misol |
|---|---|---|---|
| SAST | kod (SQLi, hardcoded secret) | PR | Semgrep, CodeQL, gosec |
| SCA | dependency CVE, litsenziya | PR + kunlik | govulncheck, Trivy, Snyk |
| DAST | ishlayotgan ilova (header, XSS) | staging | OWASP ZAP |
| Quality gate | sifat metrikalari | PR | SonarQube |

**Amalda:**
```bash
govulncheck ./...                               # faqat haqiqatan chaqirilgan zaif funksiyalar
semgrep ci
trivy fs --scanners vuln,secret,misconfig --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 .
docker run -t ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable zap-baseline.py -t https://staging.acme.uz
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hamma eski qarz bo'yicha gate — birinchi kuni hamma narsa qizil, jamoa skanerni o'chiradi. Faqat **yangi kod** bo'yicha.
- False positive'larni boshqarish jarayoni yo'q — shovqin, ishonch yo'qoladi.
- Har finding bloklaydi — critical bloklasin, qolgani ticket.
- DAST'ni prod'da ruxsatsiz ishlatish.

**Senior nuqta:** Skanerlar soni emas, signal sifati muhim: reachability tahlili (govulncheck), VEX va egalik (har finding kimga tegishli) bo'lmasa, xavfsizlik vositalari "shovqin generatori"ga aylanadi.
